fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails; the rest key is named before they start; the hint says the pivot did move, Edit > Undo first, then the rest key's time

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first. Then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the rest key before the try ("Pop is at rest, full size and level, at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s"). The Turn 3 hint says the pivot did move though it looked like nothing happened, asks for Edit > Undo first and only then the playhead on 4.3 s, and says "far below it" only because the tool returned outside_side "below".

Turn 3 says what is off and where, using Pop, 3.3 s and 4.3 s (pivot moved far below while Pop was shrunk at 3.3 s), then hands the retry back with "Say done when it's there"; it neither fixes anything nor offers to.

Pop, Door's left edge (proposal middle-left), 4.3 s (check_times and check_time), 3.3 s (check time/now) and "below" (outside_side) all come from tool results, and "shrunk" or "full size" follow from at_rest false at 3.3 s against rest at 4.3 s.

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the rest time before the try ("Pop is at rest and full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s"), and the Turn 3 hint says the pivot did move though it looked like nothing, asks for Edit > Undo first, then the playhead on 4.3 s; "far below it" matches the tool's outside_side "below".
Turn 3 says what is off and where (Pop's pivot moved far below it at 3.3 s, away from rest) and points the learner to Edit > Undo and 4.3 s without doing it or offering to.
Every layer and time named matches the tool results: Pop, Door, the 4.3 s check_time, and the 3.3 s check time from anchor_check ("time": 3.3).
